The ClawSweeper review engine as a runnable artefact: a PINNED upstream checkout,
Node 24 + pnpm 12.4.1, the OpenAI Codex CLI (the engine's only runner), a
CODEX_HOME configured for the OpenCharly Ollama Cloud endpoint, and an
`opencharly` target-profile overlay so any opencharly/<repo> resolves.

This image is the REVIEW HALF of PR validation. It is run as a disposable
container with the PR tree mounted read-only and NO GitHub token: `--local-range`
reads merge-base(base, HEAD)..HEAD and performs no GitHub writes, so the verdict
leaves the sandbox as JSON and the caller posts it. Codex's sandbox needs
bubblewrap and unprivileged user namespaces; the runner image enables those.

The engine/endpoint pairing is MEASURED, not assumed: Codex 0.162.1 speaks
stateless Responses to https://ollama.com/v1 and performs real shell tool calls
(probe: `codex exec` ran `uname -s && uname -m`, returned Linux/x86_64). Codex
accepts only `wire_api = "responses"`; Ollama Cloud serves that.

## Acceptance plan

This candy's `plan:` — the runnable spec `charly check` executes against a live deployment. `check:` steps are idempotent probes; `run:` steps change state.

| Intent | Step |
|---|---|
| `run` | install the pinned Node runtime from the official tarball |
| `run` | install the pinned pnpm and the pinned Codex CLI |
| `run` | clone the pinned ClawSweeper checkout and build it |
| `run` | add the opencharly target-profile fallback so any opencharly/<repo> resolves |
| `run` | write the Codex home configured for the Ollama Cloud endpoint |
| `run` | install the one-shot review entrypoint |
| `check` | Node 24 reports its version |
| `check` | pnpm reports the pinned version |
| `check` | the Codex CLI reports the pinned version |
| `check` | the built engine loads and resolves an opencharly target through the overlay |
| `check` | the opencharly target fallback is present |
| `check` | the Codex home carries config.toml naming the Ollama Cloud responses endpoint |
| `check` | the entrypoint gives Codex a writable home as the image's own user |
| `check` | the one-shot review entrypoint runs and describes its invocation |
| `run` | pre-install the engine's input scanner into the image user's cache |
| `check` | the input scanner is baked into THIS user's private cache |
